calibrated_validation.description: Each material disclosure was met with specific recognition: the opening reply names the panic and the bind between financial future and protecting two friends, the childhood-friendship guilt is held directly ('a friendship that goes back to age seven is rare... feels like abandoning people you love'), and the friend-group ostracism is acknowledged with the point that none of the friends carry the lease liability. The help also uses the disclosed stakes (same-day deadline, Dee's homelessness, credit risk) in the substance — offering a negotiated move-out window that actually buys Dee time — and gives firm advice without seizing any send or choice, so there is no V2 or V3.
